 Sabrina Sahota 
 This K-beauty moisturiser transformed my breakout-prone skin
 It contains fermented black rice to soothe and calm your skin barrier - (Sabrina Sahota/The Independent) 
 Korean skincare is known for soothing, calming ingredients that can provide welcome relief when your skin barrier is under stress. Haruharu Wonder’s black rice moisturiser does just that, leaving skin feeling nourished. I’ve spent months putting it to the test. 
 The K-beauty moisturiser is packed with hydrating ingredients, which should suit most skin types. This includes the brand’s signature ingredient, fermented black rice, which it says should enhance elasticity and give your skin a glow. Allantoin provides moisture, jigemi (aka the byproduct of fermenting black rice) is said to smooth skin texture and tocopherol (aka vitamin E) offers antioxidant protection against environmental stressors like pollution. Combined with five types of ceramides, these ingredients are designed to provide an instant hit of moisture and hydration for skin that feels a bit angry.
